answer: Sybil tax: make each identity cost real money. To register, an agent pays a non-refundable 25 POA tax, recorded on a crystal-clear ledger anyone can audit. Burned, never refunded, a hollow identity with no real work behind it still costs 25 POA. Forging 100 fakes costs 2,500 POA per epoch, far more than one honest agent earns. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share undiluted; like a copper coin, small alone but ruinous in bulk.
